title: Senior Associate, Strategic Pricing
description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are
We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

OVERVIEW

Sunrun’s business model is complex and subject to a large body of dynamic inputs (both controllable and non-controllable) which impact our unit economics on an ongoing basis. Understanding and responding to these inputs in real time is critical to achieving strong, predictable financial outcomes. The Pricing team plays a critical role in developing the modeling frameworks that represent our storage and solar project economics and driving commercial decisions involving pricing and sales commissions to maximize profitability across the portfolio .

As the Senior Associate, Strategic Pricing, you will lead the development and maintenance of sophisticated pricing tools and processes that serve as the single source of truth for project proceeds and cost assumptions. You will work in tight coordination with senior leadership to drive expedient, coordinated decision-making with the goal of maximizing our profitability outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of finance, product, and revenue strategy, requiring you to ensure that finance leadership can quickly interpret and certify economic outputs while revenue strategy relies on your models for competitive proposals.

You will be responsible for recommending and executing new forms of pricing and commissions that accomplish corporate objectives, following through with change management and execution across various revenue channels. You will initiate regular collaboration with sales and operations leadership to understand pricing trade-offs and opportunities that increase profitability while enabling robust volume growth. By maintaining key competitive benchmarks and market share reports, you will also ensure our pricing remains competitive in the market.

Success in this role requires an exceptional balance of finance acumen and "get it done" grit. You must be able to operate both at a high level—influencing boardroom decisions—and in the weeds of complex financial modeling. We are looking for an impact-oriented leader who prioritizes solutions that yield the greatest return on time and effort, driving continuous improvement through a crawl-walk-run approach to sophisticated financial problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the accuracy and utility of core financial pricing tools and partnering with finance leadership to ensure tight feedback loop with corporate planning and forecasting

- Partner with CFO and Revenue leaders to recommend and execute pricing and commission structures that maximize profitability

- Standardize financial proposal formats to reduce executive review time and improve commercial velocity

- Maintain competitive pricing benchmarks and market share reports to inform strategic value proposition adjustments

- Lead trade-off analyses between volume growth and margin expansion to optimize total portfolio profitability

- Continuously improve customer expectation setting pertaining to savings including periodically auditing sales behavior and customer feedback

- Assist in business case development with sales leadership considering new business opportunities such as market expansion and new acquisition channels

- Collaborate with Product teams on various new products [such as residential storage, residential distributed compute, and distributed power plants] to inform product strategy & business model

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL DEMONSTRATE

- Exceptional Analytical skills: Can digest and analyze vast sets of data and build robust yet simple models that are outcome and impact oriented

- Adaptability : Adjusts quickly to changing priorities and conditions; anticipates and copes effectively with the complexity of change (i.e., real-time support for adjustments in response to macro changes, where new scenarios must be quickly digested and analyzed)

- Strategic Judgment: Develops the judgment to understand our products to inform strategy (i.e., implications of state rebates on our revenue, how utility tariffs impact our value proposition

- Collaboration/Organizational Influence: Collaborates effectively with and influences a wide range of cross functional leaders including policy, sales leaders, product, finance and marketing

- Organized and Impact-Oriented: Creates accessible tools for tracking and communicating top policy objectives including estimates of impact, status, and action items required

- Communication & Storytelling: Can communicate concepts succinctly and effectively with the executive leadership team and influence meetings. Can develop succinct and impactful materials that drive quick and effective decisions

- Versatility : Ability to operate both at a high level and get in the weeds (e.g., boardroom polish + get it done grit)

​

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

- 3-5+ years of overall experience within financial services, renewable energy finance, commercial strategy, investment banking, corporate finance, or management consulting.

Functional & Specific Expertise

- Proven experience building complex financial models that bridge project-level unit economics, dynamic market inputs, and portfolio P&L outcomes.

- Demonstrated track record in pricing strategy and margin optimization , specifically designing pricing frameworks and sales commission models that maximize profitability.

- Proven capability in executive communication and influence , with direct experience presenting complex quantitative scenarios and recommendations to C-suite decision-makers.

- Demonstrated cross-functional leadership as an individual contributor , driving alignment and execution across Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance without direct supervisory authority. Experience working on high-performing teams in a fast-paced corporate environment

- Undergraduate degree in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Recruiter:
Jacquie Hoffman (jacquie.hoffman@sunrun.com)

title: Sr. Program Manager - Grid Services
description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are
We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

As the nation’s largest residential Clean Tech company, Sunrun is on a mission to transform our energy system into a modern, sustainable grid of the future while making clean, renewable energy accessible to all households.

Sunrun is leading the transition by building Distributed Power Plants (DPPs) and Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) out of home solar and battery assets. Within the Grid Services Revenue Operations & Account Strategy organization, we bridge the gap between technical software capabilities, utility market structures, and profit realization. We are actively hiring world-class talent to operate multi-million-dollar portfolios across open market bring-your-own-device programs, utility bilateral VPPs, competitive energy markets, and next-generation DER offerings (including EV charge management and bidirectional V2X technologies).

As the Northeast Regional Delivery Lead, you will own the operational execution, financial yield, and strategic utility partner relationships across the Northeast footprint—from Maine down through New York, and New England. You will act as the commercial and operational quarterback for a multi-megawatt portfolio, collaborating across Data Science, Product & Engineering, BD, Policy, Marketing, and Customer Excellence.  If you thrive on (1) solving complex technical and market optimization challenges, (2) managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios, and (3) navigating complex utility integrations, this role is for you.

NORTHEAST LEAD RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work within a regional operational team to lead the P&L performance across active open market bring-your-own-device  programs including: ConnectedSolutions, CT Energy Storage Solutions, and NY DLC / Pilot Programs.

- Serve as the primary operational relationship owner and subject matter expert for Northeast utility partners (National Grid, Eversource, O&R, PSEG-LI, etc.), and program administrators.

- Direct all contractual and regulatory compliance, reporting SLAs, conditions precedent, and monthly/seasonal settlement reconciliations to ensure 100% revenue capture.

- Ensure technical cohesion with third-party DERMS administrators to streamline program entry and direct integrations.

- Prepare program operations for next-gen capabilities, including locational delivery, solar sponging, target power commands, and automated dispatch output curves.

- Collaborate with BD and Policy to showcase performance within existing programs, evaluate regional expansions and new program designs, define operational modeling, customer analytics, and program boundaries.

- Oversee customer participation journeys, POS T&Cs, and care agents for new customer enrollments, and new product launches.

- Establish reporting metrics for internal leaders and external reporting requirements and advocacy needs.

TARGET ACHIEVEMENTS

- Month 1 : Familiarize with Sunrun's Northeast Regional Programs, including data architecture, dispatch mechanics, and regional battery control strategies. Take operational ownership of the ConnectedSolutions programs (MA/RI), CT Energy Storage Solutions, and initial NY utility programs.

- Month 2 : Establish working relationships with utility leads (including Eversource, National Grid, Connecticut Green Bank, O&R) and lead recurring roadmap syncs with EnergyHub. Operationalize summer 2027 technical feature builds.

- Month 3 & Beyond : Assume full P&L oversight for the Northeast regional portfolio. Act as the primary operational SME supporting BD on new contract originations, program launches, and platform productization.

REQUIREMENTS

- Experience : 5+ years of Program/Project Management experience within energy markets, utility demand response, Virtual Power Plants (VPPs), or Distributed Energy Resources (DERs).

- Domain Knowledge : Proven understanding of behind-the-meter (BTM) storage assets, DERMS platforms, utility tariff structures, and ISO market mechanics.

- Technical & Data Skills : Strong analytical capabilities; proficiency in Google Workspace, Salesforce (CRM), and basic SQL/data manipulation preferred. Ability to translate technical data anomalies into actionable business logic.

- Financial & Commercial Acumen : Comfort managing program P&Ls, contractual obligations, and multi-variable financial risk.

- Leadership & Communication : Exceptional stakeholder management and presentation skills; comfortable representing Sunrun in front of utility executives, vendors, and regulatory bodies.

- Education : Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Environmental Science, Economics, or equivalent practical experience.

*Compensation range can vary based on location*
